description.narrative:
The Department of Labour and Employment (DOLE), in consultation with the workers' and employers' organizations, conducted a Gap Analysis of ILO Convention No. 190. The legal review was validated through a tripartite workshop, "National Tripartite Feedback eForum Towards the Ratification of ILO Convention No. 190", on 19 February 2021.
DOLE further established a tripartite-plus coordination mechanism to support the ratification process: the "ILO Convention No. 190 Technical Working Committee (TWC)" through to the issuance Administrative Order No. 166, series of 2021. The TWC includes DOLE, trade unions, Employers Confederation of the Philippines (ECOP), other government agencies, and civil society organizations.
A Joint Statement of the Leaders Forum in support of ILO Convention No. 190 ratification was issued on August 19, 2021 by workers' and employers' organizations to actively participate in the ratification process initiated by the Philippine Government (including Employers Confederation of the Philippines ECOP, Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry PCCI, PHILEXPORT, Federation of Free Workers FFW, Sentro ng mga Nagkakaisa at Progresibong Manggagawa (SENTRO)SENTRO, and Trade Union Congress of the Philippines TUCP). The ILO supported constituents in carrying out the gap analysis vis-à-vis ILO Convention No. 190, by providing extensive technical support, including through online consultations in 2020.
The ILO also supported DOLE TWC on C190 in carrying out consultations with tripartite constituents, including:
a) tripartite-plus consultation and validation workshop, entitled "National Tripartite Feedback e-Forum Towards the Ratification of ILO Convention No. 190". The workshop took place on 19 February 2021;
b) Workers' Forum on C190 co-organized with SENTRO Sentro ng mga Nagkakaisa at Progresibong Manggagawa (SENTRO) and NAGKAISA Labor Coalition conducted in July 2021;
c) Consultation with Philippine Association of Service Exporters, Inc. (PASEI) in July 2021 and ECOP in September 2021.
The ILO advocated for the expansion of the ILO Convention 190 Technical Working Committee (AO No. 39 and 39-A, series of 2020) through several meetings in 2020 to include tripartite constituents and social partners and other key government agencies in addition to DOLE. TWC endorsed this request, resulting in issuance of AO No. 166, series of 2021, expanding the TWC, which now includes several trade unions, ECOP, other government agencies, and civil society organisations.
